本课的学习目标
A nutshell overview of the lecture

Slide 3

By the end of this lecture, you will be able to understand

  • the fundamental methods of Information Extraction (IE)
  • IE techniques to a variety of downstream applications
  • Named Entity Recognition (NER)
  • How to extract relations and events from unstructured data
  • How to extract facts and sentiments from text
  • multimodal IE across text, images, and documents
  • Information Extraction with Large Language Models

学完本课应能理解: Information Extraction 信息抽取 (IE) 的基本方法; IE 技术怎样用于各种下游应用; Named Entity Recognition 命名实体识别 (NER); 怎样从非结构化数据中抽取关系和事件; 怎样从文本中抽取事实和情感; 跨文本、图像、文档的多模态 IE; 用大语言模型做信息抽取.

「downstream application 下游应用」指在 IE 结果之上搭建的应用 (检索、问答、知识图谱等): IE 处在流程的上游, 为它们提供结构化数据.

Referat: 三人一组的课堂报告
Grading (Seminar) · Referat · Referat (cont’)

Slide 10–12

Referat

  • Each student who wants a Schein/Credit should make a sub-presentation on IE
  • Groups of three students per topic will be formed.
  • Each student will hold a sub-presentations on a single sub-topic, about 12-15 minutes.
  • Seminar topics will be presented in roughly in the same order as the related topics are discussed in the Lecture.
  • In the Lecture, you will be presented a detailed overview of the theme by me.
  • In the Referat, you will focus on particular aspect of the selected topic.
    • 3 presentations on a single topic by 3 students, each is 12-15 minutes.
    • 15 minutes for the audience to ask questions, a few more minutes for discussion.

Referat (cont’) (3 presentations on a single topic by 3 students)

  • The first student will introduce the selected topic by presenting the problem, its motivation, and one key paper. The presentation should explain the broader research problem, why it is important and interesting, and how the chosen paper addresses it. (Task/Problem definition and Motivation)
  • The second student will present one or two additional papers that propose different approaches to the same problem (Methods, Evaluation metrics), including the discussion of their limitations.
  • The third student will present the most recent approaches on the topic and provide a brief comparative analysis of the approaches discussed in the previous presentations. The presentation should conclude with a brief summary of the SOTA and potential future directions.

想拿学分 (Schein/Credit) 的学生都要做一个关于 IE 的分报告. 三人一组、一组一个主题, 每人讲其中一个子话题, 12–15 分钟; 三人讲完后有 15 分钟提问, 再加几分钟讨论. 研讨课的主题顺序大致跟讲座一致: 讲座里讲师先给出整体概览, 报告则聚焦这个主题的某个方面.

三个人的分工固定:

谁讲什么关键词
第一位介绍主题: 问题是什么、为什么重要有趣, 并讲一篇关键论文怎样解决它任务/问题定义, 动机
第二位讲一到两篇用不同方法解决同一问题的论文, 包括评价指标和局限方法, 评价指标, 局限
第三位讲最新方法, 简要比较前面讲过的所有方法, 最后总结 SOTA 和未来方向比较分析, SOTA, 展望

SOTA = state of the art, 目前最好的水平.

原文笔误: 「will be presented in roughly in the same order」多了一个 in; 「Each student will hold a sub-presentations」单复数不一致.

Hinrich Schütze 就在 LMU 的 CIS. 选读书讲的是信息检索 (Information Retrieval, 从大量文档中找出相关的文档), 和信息抽取 (从文档中取出结构化的事实) 是相邻但不同的任务.

什么是信息抽取
Intro · Information extraction (IE)

定义
Information extraction (IE)

Slide 18–19
  • The topic "Information Extraction" means different things to different people
  • In this course we will look at several different perspectives
  • There is unfortunately no comprehensive textbook that includes all of these perspectives
  • IE in NLP is the process of automatically extracting structured information from unstructured or semi-structured text data.
  • So that it can be easily analyzed, searched, and visualized.
  • IE involves identifying specific entities, relationships, and events of interest in text data, such as named entities like people, organizations, dates and locations.

「信息抽取」对不同的人意味着不同的东西; 课上会看几种视角, 可惜没有一本教材把它们都包括进去.

定义: 在自然语言处理中, IE 是从unstrukturiert 非结构化或半结构化的文本数据中自动抽取strukturiert 结构化信息的过程, 目的是让信息容易分析、检索和可视化. 它包括识别文本中感兴趣的Entität 实体、Relation 关系和Ereignis 事件, 例如人名、机构名、日期和地点这类命名实体.

「结构化」的意思是: 结果可以放进数据库表格的行和列, 每一格有固定的含义 (如「公司」「总部所在地」).

语言分析的层次
Levels of Linguistic Analysis

Slide 20

Phonetics and Phonology → Segmentation → Morphology → Syntax → Semantics → Pragmatics and Discourse

(Treppendiagramm: die Ebenen sind von oben links nach unten rechts gestaffelt.)

语言分析从低到高的层次: 语音学与音系学 → 切分 (分句、分词) → 形态学 → 句法 → 语义 → 语用与篇章. IE 主要依赖切分、形态和句法分析的结果, 目标在语义层: 抽取「谁和谁有什么关系」这类意义信息.

输入和输出
Information extraction · Search Problems in old times

Slide 21–22
  • Input (unstructured) : such as text documents
    Various sources: web, e-mail, journals, …
  • Output (structured): Relevant fragments of text and relations possibly to be processed later in some automated way

(Abbildung: viele Dokumente → IE → Datenbank ← User Queries. Slide from McCallum)

Search Problems in old times ☺

From unstructured text : baker job opening

To structured form:
Job Openings:

  • Category = Food Services
  • Keyword = Baker
  • Location = Continental U.S.

(Screenshot einer Google-Suche nach „baker job opening“; Treffer markiert: „Baker, a job opening“, „Mt. Baker, the school district“, „Baker Hostetler, the company“. Slide from Cohen/Mccallum via Alex Fraser’s slide deck)

输入是非结构化的文本 (网页、电子邮件、期刊…), 输出是结构化的: 相关的文本片段及其关系, 存进数据库, 供以后自动处理, 用户直接对数据库查询.

「旧时代的搜索问题」: 搜 baker job opening (面包师职位空缺), 关键词搜索会返回各种含 Baker 的结果: 真正的面包师职位, 但也有 Mt. Baker 学区、Baker Hostetler 律所. 关键词匹配分不清「Baker」是职业、地名还是公司名. 如果先把招聘广告抽取成结构化的记录 (类别 = 餐饮服务, 关键词 = 面包师, 地点 = 美国本土), 就能精确查询. 这正是 IE 的动机: 同一个词在不同语境里是不同类型的实体.

文档的结构化程度不同
Not all documents are created equal…

Slide 23
  • Varying regularity in document collections
  • Natural or unstructured
    • Little obvious structural information
  • Partially structured
    • Contain some canonical formatting
  • Highly structured
    • Often, automatically generated

Slide from McCallum

文档集合的规整程度各不相同: 自然/非结构化的 (新闻、邮件正文) 几乎没有明显的结构信息; 部分结构化的有一些固定的格式 (如简历、商品页面的标题和字段); 高度结构化的通常是自动生成的 (如由数据库模板生成的网页). 越结构化, 抽取越容易, 可以用简单的规则或模板; 越自然, 越需要语言分析和统计/神经方法.

从非结构化到结构化
Information Extraction: Unstructured to structured

Slide 24

Elvis Presley was a famous rock singer.
…
Mary once remarked that the only attractive thing about the painter Elvis Hunter was his first name.

→ Information Extraction →

GNameFNameOccupation
ElvisPresleysinger
ElvisHunterpainter
.........

“Seeing the Web as a table”

Slide from Suchanek

两句话里各有一个叫 Elvis 的人; IE 把它们变成一张表: 名 (GName, given name)、姓 (FName, family name)、职业. 口号是「把整个 Web 看成一张表」: 网上的文字里藏着大量事实, IE 的目标是把它们整理成可以查询的表格.

第二句很能说明难度: 「Mary」也是人名, 但句子里没有她的职业, 不该进表; 「painter」和「Elvis Hunter」之间的关系要靠句法 (同位语) 才看得出来.

IE 的处理流程
Information Extraction (pipeline)

Slide 25

Tip of the hat: Suchanek

读图: 左列从上到下, 然后右列从上到下:

  1. Source Selection 来源选择: 从哪些文档里抽 (图中的「?」).
  2. Tokenization & Normalization 切分与规范化: 例如把日期 05/01/67 统一成 1967-05-01.
  3. Named Entity Recognition 命名实体识别: 在「… married Elvis on 1967-05-01」中认出 Elvis 是人、1967-05-01 是日期.
  4. Instance Extraction 实例抽取: 实体属于哪个类别 (Elvis Presley 是 musician, Angela Merkel 是 politician).
  5. Fact Extraction 事实抽取: 实体之间的关系 (Married: Elvis Presley – Priscilla Beaulieu; CEO: Tim Cook – Apple).
  6. Ontological Information Extraction 本体信息抽取: 把事实放进一个本体 (类别体系、知识库) 里, 「And Beyond!」指再往后的推理等.

Fabian Suchanek 是知识库 YAGO 的作者之一; YAGO 正是从维基百科中自动抽取实体、类别和事实建成的, 这张图就是这类系统的流程.

另一个例子: 化学教学中的学生对话
Information Extraction (another example)

Slide 26 (= Slide 43)

Student dialogs during a collaborative task in chemistry education

{"episode_id": "D3G2SM5",
"smno": "SM5",
"entities": [
{"entity": "mmHg",
"how_mentioned": ”without converting to mm Hg ",
"understanding": "correct"},
{"entity": "barometric pressure",
"how_mentioned": "Patm",
"understanding": "correct"}

IE 不只用于新闻和网页. 这里的输入是学生合作完成化学任务时的对话, 输出是 JSON: 对话片段编号, 对话中提到的实体 (概念, 如 mmHg 毫米汞柱、barometric pressure 大气压), 学生怎样提到它 (如用符号 Patm 指大气压), 以及学生对它的理解是否正确. 右边的图把抽出的概念连成网络. 这类结构化结果可以用来分析学习过程, 或给知识增强的聊天机器人用 (Slide 43 用的是同一个例子).

幻灯片小错: JSON 里「"how_mentioned": ”without converting to mm Hg "」的开头是弯引号 ”, 结尾是直引号 ", 这样的 JSON 不合法, 解析会报错; 应都用直引号 ".

IE 任务的全景
Landscape of IE Tasks

实体和关系的复杂程度
Landscape of IE Tasks: Complexity of entities/relations

Slide 27
Closed setRegular set
U.S. states
He was born in Alabama…
The big Wyoming sky…		U.S. phone numbers
Phone: (413) 545-1323

Cincinnati, Ohio 45210		Person names
…was among the six houses sold by Hope Feldman that year.
Pawel Opalinski, Software Engineer at WhizBang Labs.

Slide from McCallum

按要抽取的东西有多难, 从易到难:

  • 封闭集合: 可能的值有限, 列个表就能查 (美国 50 个州).
  • 正则集合: 形式固定, 用正则表达式就能描述 (美国电话号码 (413) 545-1323 或 412-268-1299).
  • 复杂模式: 结构有规律但变化多 (邮政地址: 机构、信箱/街道、城市、州缩写、邮编, 行数和顺序会变).
  • 有歧义、需要语境和多方面证据的模式 (人名): 没有固定格式, 而且会和别的东西重名. 例子特意选了 Hope: 在左边的地址里 Hope 是阿肯色州的一个城市 (Hope, AR), 在右边是人名 Hope Feldman.

前两类正好对应本系课程「形式语言」里的内容: 封闭集合可以写成有限的词表, 正则集合可以写成正则表达式 / 有限自动机. 例如电话号码大致是 \(?\d{3}\)?[ -]?\d{3}-\d{4}.

抽取什么、怎样表示
Landscape of IE Tasks: What to extract and how to represent

Slide 28

Jack Welch will retire as CEO of General Electric tomorrow. The top role at the Connecticut company will be filled by Jeffrey Immelt.

Single entityBinary relationshipN-ary record
Person: Jack Welch

Person: Jeffrey Immelt

Location: Connecticut		Relation: Person-Title
Person: Jack Welch
Title: CEO

Relation: Company-Location
Company: General Electric
Location: Connecticut		Relation: Succession
Company: General Electric
Title: CEO
Out: Jack Welsh
In: Jeffrey Immelt

"Named entity" extraction

Slide from McCallum

同一段话 (「Jack Welch 明天将卸任通用电气 CEO, 这家康涅狄格州公司的最高职位将由 Jeffrey Immelt 接任.」) 可以抽出三种复杂程度的结构:

  • 单个实体: 人名、地名, 这就是命名实体抽取.
  • 二元关系: 两个实体之间的一种关系 (人–职位, 公司–所在地). 注意「Connecticut company」和「General Electric」要靠指代 (the Connecticut company = General Electric) 才连得起来.
  • N 元记录: 一个事件涉及多个角色 (继任事件: 公司、职位、离任者、接任者), 相当于一张表的一整行, 也叫模板填充.

幻灯片错误: N 元记录里「Out: Jack Welsh」拼错, 原句和前两栏都是 Jack Welch. 这正好说明为什么抽取后还要做实体规范化: 拼法一变, 程序就会把它当成另一个人.

IE 的方法
Methods for IE

Slide 29–30
  1. Rule-Based Approaches with manually engineered rules
    • rules defined over words/entities: “<company> located in <location>”
    • rules defined over parsed text: “(Subj:<company>) (Verb:located) (*) (Obj: <location>)”
  2. Traditional ML-Based Approaches
    • Supervised: Train a relation classifier using labeled examples; Learns patterns automatically from annotated data
    • Partially-supervised: bootstrap rules/patterns from “seed” examples; Iteratively discover new patterns and relations
  3. Deep Learning & Pre-trained Language Models
    • CNNs, RNNs, LSTMs
    • Transformer-based models: BERT, RoBERTa etc.
    • Fine-tune for: Named Entity Recognition (NER), Relation Extraction (RE), Event Extraction
  4. Large Language Models (LLMs)
    • GPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama, etc.
    • Information extraction via prompting
    • Zero-shot and few-shot extraction
    • Structured outputs (JSON, knowledge graphs)
    Example Prompt: "Extract all companies and headquarters locations from this text."

Rules → Traditional ML → Deep Learning → Pre-trained Transformers → LLM-based IE

IE 方法的发展, 大致四代:

方法怎么做例子
基于规则人工写规则, 可以定义在词/实体上, 也可以定义在句法分析结果上「<公司> located in <地点>」; (主语: 公司)(动词: located)(…)(宾语: 地点)
传统机器学习有监督: 用标注好的例子训练关系分类器, 从标注数据中自动学模式; 半监督 (partially-supervised): 从少量「种子」例子出发 bootstrap 自举出规则和模式, 迭代地发现新模式和新关系种子: (Apple, Cupertino) → 找到含这对词的句子 → 学到模式「X is headquartered in Y」→ 用它找新的对
深度学习与预训练模型CNN、RNN、LSTM; 基于 Transformer 的 BERT、RoBERTa 等, 针对 NER、关系抽取、事件抽取微调BERT + 每个词一个标签 (序列标注)
大语言模型GPT、Claude、Gemini、Llama 等; 直接用提示 (prompt) 抽取; 零样本 (不给例子) 和少样本 (给几个例子); 输出结构化格式 (JSON、知识图谱)「从这段文字里抽出所有公司及其总部所在地」

后一代并没有完全取代前一代: 规则方法在高度结构化的文档和小数据场景里仍然常用, 而 LLM 的输出也需要用规则或校验来保证格式正确.

第一部分: IE 的基础与方法
PART-I: Basics and Methods for IE

Slide 32–33

Fundamentals

  • History of Information Extraction (IE)
  • Relationship to NLP, Information Retrieval, and Knowledge Discovery
  • Source Selection
  • Text Preprocessing: Tokenization and Normalization etc.

Methods

  • Traditional approaches: Feature Engineering, Decision Trees, Linear Models
  • Representation Learning: Static and contextualized embeddings
  • Deep Learning: Neural Networks, Transformer Models; Knowledge-Enriched IE; LLM-Based Information Extraction

第一部分的内容. 基础: IE 的历史; 它和 NLP、Information Retrieval 信息检索、Knowledge Discovery 知识发现的关系; 来源选择; 文本预处理 (切分、规范化等). 方法: 传统方法 (Feature Engineering 特征工程、决策树、线性模型); 表示学习 (静态词向量如 word2vec, 每个词一个固定向量; 上下文相关的词向量如 BERT, 同一个词在不同句子里向量不同); 深度学习 (神经网络、Transformer、知识增强的 IE、基于 LLM 的 IE).

第二部分: 应用
PART-II: Applications

命名实体识别
Named Entity Recognition

Slide 34–35
  • Named Entity Recognition (NER) is a natural language processing technique that identifies and classifies named entities within text data.
  • Named entities refer to real-world objects such as persons, organizations, locations, dates, and more

Example: Extract the Named Entities in the following article-

“Citing high fuel prices, United Airlines said Friday it has increased fares by $6 per round trip on flights to some cities also served by lower cost carriers. American Airlines, a unit of AMR Corp., immediately matched the move, spokesman Tim Wagner said. United, a unit of UAL Corp., said the increase took effect Thursday and applies to most routes where it competes against discount carriers, such as Chicago to Dallas and Denver to San Francisco”

Citing high fuel prices, [ORG United Airlines] said [TIME Friday] it has increased fares by [MONEY $6] per round trip on flights to some cities also served by lower-cost carriers. [ORG American Airlines], a unit of [ORG AMR Corp.], immediately matched the move, spokesman [PER Tim Wagner] said. [ORG United], a unit of [ORG UAL Corp.], said the increase took effect [TIME Thursday] and applies to most routes where it competes against discount carriers, such as [LOC Chicago] to [LOC Dallas] and [LOC Denver] to [LOC San Francisco].

NER 识别文本中的命名实体并分类. 命名实体指现实世界中的对象: 人、机构、地点、日期等. 例子里的标签: ORG 机构, PER 人, LOC 地点, TIME 时间, MONEY 金额.

值得注意的几处: 「United」单独出现时也要标为 ORG (它是 United Airlines 的简称); 「Friday」「Thursday」是时间表达式, 后面还要规范化成具体日期; 「$6」是金额. 这个例子出自 Jurafsky & Martin 的教材.

关系抽取
Relation Extraction

Slide 36

finding and classifying semantic relation extraction relations among entities mentioned in a text,

  • child-of (X is the child-of Y),
  • part-whole or
  • geospatial relations
    • Located-on
    • South of

Example: determine the relationship (if any) between airline announcements of fare increases and the behavior of their stocks the next day.

(Derselbe Text wie auf Slide 34; hervorgehoben: „American Airlines, a unit of AMR Corp.“, „spokesman Tim Wagner“, „United, a unit of UAL Corp.“, „Chicago to Dallas and Denver to San Francisco“.)

关系抽取: 找出文本中提到的实体之间的语义关系并分类, 例如亲属关系 (child-of: X 是 Y 的孩子)、整体-部分关系、地理空间关系 (位于…上、在…以南). 例子中标出的就是关系: American Airlines 是 AMR Corp. 的一个部门 (part-of / 子公司关系), Tim Wagner 是 (American Airlines 的) 发言人 (雇佣关系), United 是 UAL Corp. 的部门, 以及航线的起点和终点.

幻灯片上「判断航空公司提价公告与次日股价表现之间的关系」是一个应用场景: 先抽取出「哪家公司、哪天、提价多少」, 才能和股价数据对照.

原文笔误: 定义句「finding and classifying semantic relation extraction relations among entities」多了「relation extraction」两个词, 应为 finding and classifying semantic relations among entities mentioned in a text.

事件抽取与事实抽取
Event Extraction · Fact Extraction

Slide 37–38

Event Extraction

  • The task of finding events in which the detected entities participate
  • Events are also situated in time, occurring at a particular date or time, and events can be related temporally, happening before or after or simultaneously with each other.
  • Challenges: temporal expressions like Friday, Thursday or two days from now and times such as 3:30 P.M., and normalize them onto specific calendar dates or times

Fact Extraction

  • validating whether the information in the documents/sentences supports or refutes a given claim

Claim: Claire Danes is wedded to an actor from England.
[wiki/Claire_Danes] She is married to actor Hugh Dancy, with whom she has one child.
[wiki/Hugh_Dancy] Hugh Michael Horace Dancy (born 19 June 1975) is an English actor and model.
Verdict: SUPPORTED

Claim: Rogue appears in Canadian comic books.
[wiki/Rogue_(comics)] Rogue is a fictional superhero appearing in American comic books published by Marvel Comics, commonly in association with the X Men.
Verdict: REFUTED

事件抽取: 找出已识别的实体参与了哪些事件. 事件处在时间中: 发生在某个日期或时刻, 事件之间有先后或同时的时间关系. 难点是时间表达式: 「周五」「周四」「两天后」「下午 3:30」要先识别, 再规范化成具体的日历日期或时刻 (这需要知道文本的写作日期).

事实抽取 / 事实核查: 判断文档中的信息是支持还是反驳一条给定的说法. 第一个例子: 说法「Claire Danes 嫁给了一位英格兰演员」; 维基百科说她嫁给了演员 Hugh Dancy, 另一条说 Hugh Dancy 是英格兰演员, 两条证据合起来才能得出「支持」. 第二个例子: 说法「Rogue 出现在加拿大漫画里」; 证据说她出现在美国漫画里, 结论「反驳」. 例子出自事实核查数据集 FEVER.

(基于方面的) 情感抽取
(Asbect-based) Sentiment Extraction

Slide 39

Angelidis, S., & Lapata, M. (2018). Summarizing opinions: Aspect extraction meets sentiment prediction and they are both weakly supervised. arXiv preprint arXiv:1808.08858.

Aspektbasierte Sentimentanalyse 基于方面的情感分析: 不只判断整条评论是好评还是差评, 而是找出评论谈到的方面 (aspect: 画质、音质、接口、价格…) 和对每个方面的情感. 读图: 左边是 32 英寸液晶电视的一组评论; 中间每一行是一条意见 (如「颜色和清晰度很好, 令人失望的是视角」), 前面的图标表示方面; 箭头指向右边, 带 [+] 的蓝色句子是正面意见, [−] 的红色句子是负面意见; 标着 neutral (中性) 和 redundant (冗余) 的意见被丢弃. 结果是一份按方面组织的评论摘要.

原文笔误: 标题「(Asbect-based)」应为 Aspect-based.

问答与对话
Question Answering/Dialog · Question Answering

Slide 40–41
  • smart speakers (e.g. Amazon Echo, Google Home)
  • mobile devices that you can command with audio (e.g. SIRI, Cortana etc.)
  • Customer support web-based chatbots (or call-services e.g. for booking flights and tables at restaurants)
  • Interfaces to cars, robots

Question Answering

  • E.g Factoid Questions
    • Where is the Louvre Museum located?
    • Where does the energy in a nuclear explosion come from?
  • A rule-based traditional approach
    • Similarity-based answer retrieval
  • Recent SOTA LLMs
    • prompt a pretrained and instruction-tuned LLM, an LLM that has been finetuned on question/answer datasets with the question in the prompt.
    • retrieval-augmented generation or RAG

问答和对话系统的应用场景: 智能音箱、可用语音控制的手机助手、网页客服机器人 (或订机票、订餐厅的电话服务)、汽车和机器人的交互界面.

问答: 例如事实类问题 (「卢浮宫在哪里?」「核爆炸的能量来自哪里?」). 传统方法基于规则, 按相似度检索答案; 当前最好的方法是用指令微调过的 LLM (在问答数据集上微调过), 把问题放进提示里; 或者用 RAG (检索增强生成, 见第三部分).

聊天机器人 / 对话代理
Chatbots / Dialog Agents · Chatbots (Knowledge enriched)

Slide 42–43
  • also known as “conversational agents”
  • software applications that mimic written or spoken human speech for the purposes of simulating a conversation.
  • Successful communication relies upon a machine’s ability to parse human speech, extracting the domain, understand the intent (intent extraction), and turn this into machine-understandable format for successful querying (slot filling)

(Slide 43: Chatbots (Knowledge enriched) — dasselbe Beispiel „Student dialogs during a collaborative task in chemistry education“ wie Slide 26.)

聊天机器人又叫对话代理: 模仿人的书面或口头话语来模拟对话的软件. 成功的交流依赖机器能够: 解析人的话, 识别领域 (domain), 理解意图 (intent extraction 意图抽取), 并把它转成机器能理解的格式去查询 (slot filling 槽位填充). 例如「明天从慕尼黑飞柏林的航班」: 领域 = 机票, 意图 = 查航班, 槽位 = 出发地: 慕尼黑, 目的地: 柏林, 日期: 明天. 这里的意图抽取和槽位填充正是信息抽取.

读图: 用户只接触最上面的聊天界面; 中间的 NLP 层负责理解和生成语言; 它一边连记忆 (对话历史), 一边连知识库 (可查询的事实). Slide 43 说明知识增强的聊天机器人可以用 Slide 26 那种从对话中抽出的结构化信息.

第三部分: 进阶主题
PART-III: Advanced topics

多模态信息抽取
Multimodal Information Extraction

Slide 44–45

Zheng, C., Feng, J., Fu, Z., Cai, Y., Li, Q., & Wang, T. (2021, October). Multimodal relation extraction with efficient graph alignment. In Proceedings of the 29th ACM International Conference on Multimedia (pp. 5298-5306).

Multimodal 多模态 IE 同时利用文本、图像、音频、视频. 读图 (Slide 44): 推文「Forget the dresses, Ang Lee [PER] is my favorite Oscar [MISC] actor」, 只看文字很难判断 Ang Lee 和 Oscar 之间是什么关系. 图片里检测到的物体 (男人、奖杯、头发、杯子) 组成一张视觉关系图 (「man holding trophy」); 把它和文本实体图对齐 (Ang Lee ↔ man, Oscar ↔ trophy), 就能推出文本关系 Awarded 获奖: <Ang Lee, Awarded, Oscar>.

读图 (Slide 45): 任务从上到下越来越多模态: 纯文本 NER; 文本 + 图像; 文本 + 图像 + 音频 → 关系抽取并在图像和语音中定位 (例如歌手 Mika 和 Shreya Ghoshal 之间的 peer 关系); 文本 + 视频 → 事件抽取并跟踪视频中的论元 (事件类型 opening, 触发词 unpack, 施事 boy, 对象 toy); 视频 + 音频 → 事件抽取 (feeding: woman 喂 kangaroo). 输入都是自然语言指令 (「Please extract …」), 即用一个大模型统一完成各种任务.

IE 的可解释性
Explainability for IE

Slide 46
  • Why does the model make specific decisions (correct or wrong??)
    • Are the correct decisions made for the correct reasons?
    • How much can you rely on your model?

Local explainability and Global Explainability

可解释性问的是: 模型为什么做出某个决定 (无论对错)? 做对的决定是不是出于正确的理由 (还是碰巧利用了数据里的表面线索)? 你能在多大程度上依赖这个模型? 分为局部可解释性 (解释某一个具体预测, 例如哪些词让模型把「Hope」判为人名) 和全局可解释性 (解释模型整体学到了什么规律).

用大语言模型做 IE (包括 RAG)
Information Extraction with LLMs (including RAG)

Slide 47

Gen-AI generate responses based on what it learned during training! This might lead to Hallucinations.

RAG stands for Retrieval Augmented Generation.

RAG enhances AI by feeding it real-time data from reliable internal sources, allowing the model to pull in up-to-date, specific information.

  • It generates more accurate, relevant answers because it’s not limited to static knowledge.
  • It needs to accurately extract information from those sources!

生成式 AI 根据训练时学到的东西生成回答, 可能产生Halluzination 幻觉 (说得很肯定但内容是编造的). RAG 检索增强生成: 回答前先从可靠的 (例如公司内部的) 资料中检索相关内容, 和问题一起交给模型, 让模型基于最新、具体的信息作答. 好处是答案更准确、更相关, 不受训练数据截止时间的限制; 但前提是能从这些资料中准确地抽取信息, 这又回到了 IE.
